items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You had your son Chad. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Yeah, and he does sound and lighting for a giant club here, LaVela Club. And he’s good at it. In fact, they flied Chad to Mazula, Montana to do the Buddy DeFranco Festival, jazz festival, because the sound was pretty bad, and when he was, I don’t know
eight, nine years ago, he was younger of course, but he helped along and he did so well they made him the sound and light guy for that festival.
